feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 14 November 2026 5:00am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds soon developing.


##Wind)##

Southwest 4 or 5, soon backing south or southwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight, soon becoming mainly moderate, becoming moderate or rough later.


##Weather)##

Occasional showers becoming isolated in the afternoon.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 12°C
##Sea Temperature##

13°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds. Perhaps gales later.


##Wind)##

South or southwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 at first, decreasing 4 or 5 through the morning, then veering northwest 5 or 6 early afternoon. Increasing 6 or 7 early evening, and occasionally gale 8 in the evening for a time. Decreasing 4 or 5 early in the night.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough, falling slight or moderate for a time before building mainly rough later.


##Weather)##

Occasional rain, heavy at times, clearing to become mainly fair during the afternoon.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor becoming good later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 11°C
##Sea Temperature##

13°C
##Monday, 16 November 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds later.


##Wind)##

North 4 or 5, decreasing west 3 or less by midday, then sharply becoming east or southeast in the afternoon. Increasing 6 or 7 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate soon becoming slight, then moderate or rough later.


##Weather)##

Isolated showers, then rain arriving overnight.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in any showers and rain later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 5°C and max. air temperature 8°C
##Sea Temperature##

13°C

##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

East 6 or 7, backing northeast 5 or 6 in the afternoon, decreasing 4 or 5 later.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather)##

Rain, heavy at times, clearing to become fair later.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor becoming good later.


##Temperature##

##Sea Temperature##

13°C
##Wednesday, 18 November 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate becoming slight.


##Weather)##

##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers.
